303514681.name: Domaine Mongeard-Mugneret
303514681.note: The estate states 1.4440 ha in production, compared jointly with the SA and GFA rights. D0681 first appears to the SA in 2024 after a 2023 sale. Reviewed SA filings name no cru parcel or lease. Farming of D0107 and D0681 unconfirmed.

326533213.name: Domaine d'Eugénie

348024928.name: Domaine Anne Gros

393095955.name: Maison Joseph Drouhin

778269407.name: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
